name: io.github.MysterionRise/pubchem-finder
title: PubChem Finder
description: Search PubChem by structure: a local similarity/substructure index, live PubChem data, RDKit tools

runtimeArguments.name: --python
runtimeArguments.description: Python 3.11-3.14: FPSim2, numexpr and ndindex publish no wheels for 3.15 yet

environmentVariables.name: PUBCHEM_FINDER_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory for the local index and the PubChem response cache (default: the platform's user data directory)
